description.narrative:
In February 2020, the National Economic and Social Council met and discussed the follow up to the recommendations of the Committee on the Application of Standards (CAS) in 2019. The social partners agreed that the Law on Inspection Oversight should be amended. In the follow-up to the tripartite workshop, the Ministry of Labour sent a note to the Ministry of Public Administration requesting an amendment of the law. he ILO organized a Tripartite Workshop to follow-up on the conclusions of the CAS concerning the application by Serbia of the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (No. 81) and the Labour Inspection (Agriculture) Convention, 1969 (No. 129). The discussion among the tripartite partners centred on the best way to address the specific issues of conformity identified by the CAS, particularly related to the Law on Inspection Oversight. The meeting was attended by the Prime Minister of Serbia.
The ILO also assisted in the development of the Action Plan of the Economic and Social Council's Action Plan to discharge ILO related obligations.

description.narrative:
Serbia - CEACR Observation on C105
"The Committee notes with satisfaction the adoption of Act No. 6 on public gatherings on 26 January 2016 which only provides for fines and not for penalties of imprisonment in sections 20-22 within applicable penal sanctions. The Committee also notes that Public Assembly Act No. 51/92 was repealed by the Decision of the Constitutional Court of the Republic of Serbia No. IUz-204/2013 on 23 October 2015."
Repeated comments by the supervisory bodies over a number of years do encourage Governments to respond to their requests by amending the provisions, which were not in compliance with the provisions of the Convention. In the specific case of Serbia, the Committee of Experts underlined the need for a legislative change by encouraging its Government to adopt Act No. 6 on public gatherings on 26 January 2016 which only provides for fines and not for penalties of imprisonment in sections 20-22 within applicable penal sanctions, as per the recommendation of the Committee of Experts.
